learning_objective: Compare the effects of the development of colonial society in the various regions of North America.
question: Which of the following is the best comparison of the Spanish and English approaches to the labor of Native peoples?

options.A: Both empires relied mainly on wage labor performed by Native peoples working in towns
options.B: Neither empire interacted with Native peoples as a source of labor, tribute, or trade
options.C: Spain relied mainly on indentured servants, while England relied mainly on forced Native labor under the encomienda
options.D: Spain used forced labor and tribute systems, while English colonists mostly took land and used servants and slaves

explanation: Spain used institutions such as missions and labor drafts in the Southwest and Florida, while England depended on migrants and enslaved Africans and sought Native land.

distractor_notes.A: Wage labor was not the main system.
distractor_notes.B: Both empires interacted with Native peoples.
